text:
alex: Quick spike notes from this morning  looking at a two-tier metering flow: optimistic quick-credit + authoritative compacted ledger. goal: <100ms response for callers, while preserving an auditable trail.
marie: Optimistic credits must be idempotent and reversible. Can we attach a `provisional_epoch` and `origin_fingerprint` so reconciler can reason about duplicates? :white_check_mark:
dana: Sketch: 1) adapter emits `optimistic_credit` to low-latency topic (no ordering guarantees), 2) adapter also writes `ledger_envelope` to ordered topic partitioned by tenant, 3) finalizer consumes ledger_envelope, validates, then emits `ledger_commit` which authoritatively updates the billing store and produces compensating adjustments if needed.
ricardo: Two storage concerns: compaction + late-arrival. Our canonical store compacts by (tenant, day). If envelope arrives late, finalizer must be able to rehydrate raw envelope from 90d cold store and replay. We should store a compact manifest pointer in the compacted partition so we can find rehydration points.
priya: Edge-case: chunked generation requests produce multiple partial `optimistic_credit` events. Need a `session_claim` that ties fragments to a single authoritative claim. Otherwise reconciler will see many small provisional credits and struggle with aggregation.
alex: Agree on `session_claim`. Also API rule: server mints `claim_id` on ingress when missing. Clients MAY pass `client_claim` as a hint but server should canonicalize.
dana: Reconcile algorithm idea: snapshot-join on (tenant, claim_id) within `grace_window` (configurable per-tenant). If `ledger_envelope` total != sum(provisional) emit `adjustment` (+/-) and mark records final. Keep retry w/ exponential backoff for missing envelopes.
ricardo: Schema evolution: keep envelope version v1, v2. Finalizer must support forward-compat by ignoring unknown fields. Also include a `schema_checksum` on envelope so finalizer can gate behavioral differences.
priya: Observability: emit spans across adapter->topics->finalizer. Metrics: provisional_rate, envelope_ingest_rate, finalize_success_rate, adjustment_rate, reconcile_errors. Dashboards for per-tenant delta histograms.
marie: Disputes: store raw envelope + provenance for 365 days for legal/dispute teams. PII redaction rule: mask any user_text fields before cold-store. Record a `redaction_version`.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: branch `metering/two-tier-proto` deployed to staging (sha: e3c9a). watch `metering.optimistic.*` and `metering.finalizer.*` metrics.
ricardo: Rollout plan: 0.5% tenants -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. During rollout, run a nightly sampling job that compares final ledger to optimistic credits for sampled tenants and records discrepancy vector. alert if discrepancy_rate > threshold.
dana: Failure modes to document in playbook: 1) missing ledger_envelope, 2) schema decode errors, 3) cold-store rehydrate failures, 4) duplicate claim_ids across tenants (should be impossible if claim_id includes tenant prefix).
alex: For implementation I'm going to prototype the finalizer as idempotent RPC that accepts `ledger_envelope` and returns `finalize_result` (ok/adjusted/error). include small e2e harness that simulates late envelope, dropped provisional, and chunk merges. pairing sesh tomorrow 11am.
priya: One more thing: mini-contract on allowed adjustments: negative adjustments > original amount need SE approval. capture approvals in audit metadata.
marie: Love the approval guard. Also add `reconcile_reason_code` enum so downstream billing can explain adjustments to customers.
alex: Cool. I'll open INF ticket to draft rollout playbook and required dashboards. thanks all. :tada:
